requirements.statement: Add one package-owned official AIDLC bundle resolver that discovers installed-package, managed-payload, and source-checkout bundles by deterministic precedence; resolves independently of the process current working directory; verifies package and bundle integrity offline; emits a typed fingerprinted receipt with truthful provider, official identity, trust posture, artifact-identity status, verified root, network posture, and categorical issues; and leaves every missing, altered, incompatible, incomplete, unsafe, or conflicting source untouched.

path_bindings.ownership_evidence: The Phase 2 design assigns this package-owned concern to a shared resolver; repository inspection found generic resource verification and script-local validators but no equivalent package resolver.

proof_bindings.asserted_behavior: Provider discovery, deterministic precedence, safe path handling, exact inventory comparison, and receipt fingerprinting work against controlled filesystem fixtures.

The resolver receipt binds provider identity, official source/revision/commit, bundle fingerprint, trust posture, artifact-identity status, verified root, network_used false, issues, and its own stable fingerprint.

Installed-package, managed-payload, and source-checkout providers resolve independently of the current working directory, report truthful distinct trust postures, perform no network access, and preserve invalid state untouched.

positive: All three package resource providers resolve through one typed package-owned contract with deterministic precedence and no current-working-directory dependency.

A successful receipt binds the selected provider, official identity, verified bundle root, package and bundle integrity fingerprints, truthful trust posture, artifact-identity status, and network_used false.
The focused proof covers positive provider selection and every declared negative integrity state.
negative: Local hashes, legacy schema-v1 state, self-authored manifests, or unbound receipts never become authenticated-release or new-Full authority.
Resolution never accesses the network, executes pack content, follows unsafe links, or mutates source state.
This slice does not edit inspection inputs or implement project projection, future-run selection, frozen active-run binding, Full routing, or host projection.
